scope: The two requests to install PCR in the existing inference pipeline and enforce three concurrent positions with configurable win-probability cutoffs.

items.requirement: Copy the four selected model packages under E:\inference Pipeline\PCR
items.evidence: All 56 packaged files match the original selected-model source byte for byte; four model folders contain required metadata and components.

items.requirement: Save joblibs, scalers, imputers, calibration, training/inference code, requirements, metrics and model cards
items.evidence: models/*/, model_files.sha256.json, requirements.lock.txt, training_metadata.json and research/.

items.requirement: A separate /PCR HTML page and API within the existing application
items.evidence: web.py and dashboard.html; existing DashboardServer route-coexistence test passed; saved browser screenshot and earlier successful cutoff-save check are in validation/.

items.requirement: Display all four models' outputs and all signals
items.evidence: The page displays decay, calibrated win probability, both holding predictions and calibrated tail probability; every minute decision is logged and available through paginated signal records and full JSONL download. Unavailable outputs during warmup are explicitly empty.

items.requirement: Allow three simultaneous PCR positions and admit no fourth position until a slot is free
items.evidence: maximum_open_positions=3; concurrency, fourth-entry rejection, close-and-reuse, restart recovery and duplicate-worker lock tests passed. A new qualifying signal is required after a slot opens.

items.requirement: Persist an editable win-probability cutoff and require it to pass before entering
items.evidence: config.json contains four expiry-group cutoffs; /PCR/api/thresholds persists edits; runtime compares win_probability_60m >= cutoff alongside decay/tail/time/data/capacity gates; rejection test passed.

items.requirement: Use a net target of INR 3000 and net stop of INR -1500 with zero brokerage and other costs included
items.evidence: config.json and runtime.Book; itemized statutory charges and round-trip slippage are deducted from gross P&L; tests distinguish gross target from net target and verify stop exits.

items.requirement: Keep and save the original entry ATM strike through t+h
items.evidence: Entry strike, expiry, CE/PE tokens and quantity are stored in each position and used by every mark and exit; fixed-contract tests passed.

items.requirement: Save every trade and signal under PCR with daily files
items.evidence: logs/YYYY-MM-DD/ is created at runtime for inputs, minute rows, signals, intents, actions, entry/exit journal, P&L marks, session context and applied configuration changes. Subprocess/replay tests verified the files in isolated temporary ledgers.

items.requirement: Provide backtesting from the new page
items.evidence: Historical-reference job and recorded-session replay are available. The historical raw cache exists. The installation rerun exactly matches the original 902-trade result; real worker/recorded-replay parity tests passed. Results are written outside the live book.

items.requirement: Start PCR with the existing daily paper-trading application
items.evidence: The original daily scheduler calls run_live_session, which constructs and starts PCR.bridge, forwards existing feed observations, pulses the child worker and closes it with the session. The actual child-process path was exercised in an isolated test. Next normal application launch loads the integration.

items.requirement: Preserve the working existing paper-trading setup
items.evidence: The existing dashboard and both existing configuration files match their before-change hashes. All 24 existing-app regression tests passed. Integration changes in live_inference.py are additive; PCR owns separate models, configuration, worker and ledgers.

scope_and_limits: The three-position cap applies to PCR independently of existing strategies.
The selected deployment uses 60- and 120-minute holding horizons, entries through 13:00:00 IST and a 15:14:30 cutoff.
The dashboard's historical-reference job reproduces the frozen study. Editing live cutoffs does not silently rewrite that reference backtest.
Exact fresh quotes are required for exits; missing quotes produce an explicit pending exit rather than a fabricated cutoff fill.
No live market session was started, and no production trade or signal logs were populated with test data.
